title: Apple is dropping $1 billion on a huge new campus in Austin, Texas
text: ▶ Apple To Spend $1 Billion On New Campus 00:38 New Delhi (CNN Business)Apple is putting more detail on its plan to create 20,000 jobs in the United States over the next five years. The company said Thursday it will spend $1 billion to build a new campus in Austin, Texas. The city is already home to one Apple (AAPL) campus, a sprawling facility... Recent related videos from verified sources Apple says it will build a $1 billion new campus in Austin, Tex. that would almost double the size of its current footprint in the city, with the room to house as many as 15,000 new jobs. Credit: Cheddar Inc. - Published
